# Runtime reference

<!-- Generated by tools/dev.py docs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Protocol version: **1**. UDP port: **47810**.

Packets use little-endian float32 values.

| Record | Floats |
|---|---:|
| State header | 10 |
| Body | 12 |
| Event | 8 |

At most 1321 bodies and 64 events fit in one packet.

## Commands

| Command | Fields / meaning |
|---|---|
| `hello` | heartbeat (send twice per second) |
| `bye` | disconnect |
| `add` | type, pos, mode (orbit/launch), drag, mass_mult |
| `predict` | same as add, plus req |
| `belt` | pos, count, mass_mult |
| `remove` | id |
| `supernova` | id |
| `pause` | value (boolean; omit to toggle) |
| `speed` | value (clamped to 0.05–2000) |
| `clear` | no fields |
| `preset` | name |
